name: SaaS: doesn't apply an internal offer when its condition isn't met
description: The retention note allows 2 free months for yearly-plan customers only. This customer is on a monthly plan. The draft must not make the yearly-plan offer, and must not reveal the note.

input.subject: Price went up
input.body: My monthly plan just went up from $10 to $13. I'm thinking of cancelling. Anything you can do?

knowledge.title: Retention offers (internal)
knowledge.content: Only for customers on a yearly plan who mention cancelling over price: offer 2 months free on their next renewal. Monthly-plan customers get no discount; you may point them to the yearly plan, which costs less per month.

knowledge.title: Plans and pricing
knowledge.content: Monthly and yearly plans are available. Yearly plans are billed once a year and cost less per month.

mock.text:
Hi Jo, thanks for telling us, and sorry the new price is a stretch. One option is our yearly plan: it's billed once a year and costs less per month than the monthly plan. If you'd like to switch, reply here and we'll help.

Best,
Support
[sources: K1, K2]
